name: pulse
description: Live session metrics for Claude Code: cost, rate limits, context, turns, tokens, tools, subagents, files, and daily history in a pane and the prompt hint

warnAt.title: Amber at
warnAt.description: The fill, in percent, at which the context and rate-limit meters turn amber. Must be below Red at.

alertAt.title: Red at
alertAt.description: The fill, in percent, at which the context and rate-limit meters turn red. Must be above Amber at and at most 100.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache minutes
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lasts, in minutes. 0 guesses: 60 on a subscription, 5 with an API key.

stallMinutes.title: Stall alert after
stallMinutes.description: Minutes with no model output or tool call before a running turn shows a toast. 0 turns the alert off.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Today's spend in dollars, across all sessions, at which a band above the prompt warns: from 80%, and in red from 100%. 0 turns the band off.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: The pane sections to show, in order, separated by commas: header, limits, context, turns, activity, tokens, tools, files, models, agents, history, plugins. Empty shows all.
